summary.name: VEED
summary.one_liner: VEED is an AI video creation and editing platform for generating talking-head and explainer videos, editing with AI, dubbing, and adding subtitles.
keywords: make video from photo and voice
use_cases: Creating explainer or product demo videos without a camera
Generating talking-head videos from a photo and voice
Adding subtitles to social media videos
Applying brand colours, fonts and logos to videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VEED as a workflow for generating and editing videos in one place. It says users can create AI videos from one photo and their voice, with a clone that films the content. It lists generating videos from ideas without a camera, and subtitles designed to keep viewers watching. It also mentions dubbing videos and applying brand colours, fonts, logos and voice to videos automatically. The page lists related tools such as AI video generator, dubbing AI, subtitle generator and video compressor.
notable: Generates talking-head videos from one photo and voice clone
Brand kit applies colours, fonts, logos and voice to videos
AI subtitles and dubbing built into the same workflow
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific features and limits are not detailed
